limitations: This audit was designed after inspecting the cohort and is exploratory, not preregistered.
The 40 common 30-second shifts are serially correlated and not literal permutations.
The three dwells span about five minutes, so population prevalence is not established.
A matched-field p tests whether some visible catalogue curve predicts better at true time; runner separation and independent replication remain necessary for named identity.

The published source audit could combine a scalar identity and a different shape identity. The report-only gate has since been corrected, and this audit never treats mixed-identity evidence as a named-object association.

method.candidate_search: Every block re-propagates the same causal TLE snapshot, screens the shifted visible sky, selects identity and a ±0.30 s/0.05 s epoch on the first 60%, fits per-receiver offset and ±200 Hz/s drift on training only, and scores the final 40%.
method.cluster_selection: Replica clusters select one shared identity and one shared epoch; receiver offset and bounded drift remain separate. Singleton clusters reduce to the track search.
method.joint_gate_score: min(holdout_advantage/100 Hz, runner_margin/100 Hz, 500 Hz/holdout_RMS), with boundary epoch forced below zero; >=1 passes all numerical shape gates
method.named_association_statistic: min(all-receiver heldout log-MSE gain over line, training runner log-MSE separation, heldout best-alternative log-MSE separation); the epoch-interior requirement remains a separate hard gate
method.westfall_young: inclusive rank min-P using the same 41 common true/wrong-time blocks; both single-step and step-down values reported
